Reliability fixes for notes edited outside Papyra.

### 🐛 Fixes
- `.md` files created outside Papyra are picked up even without an id.
- Autosave can no longer overwrite a change made outside Papyra.
- Deleted notes always drop out of search after a restart.
- The conflict resolver's diff rows no longer collapse into narrow columns.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.3.2...v0.3.3](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.3.2...v0.3.3)
